info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server Deployment API
Application Deployments
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all application deployments

items.docs: Returns all application deployment configurations in the domain. Requires an active edit session for modification operations.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Create an application deployment

items.docs: Creates a new application deployment configuration. Requires an active edit session. The application must be accessible from the administration server file system or uploaded first.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get an application deployment

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the application deployment

items.docs: Returns the configuration of a specific application deployment.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Update an application deployment

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the application deployment

items.docs: Updates the configuration of a specific application deployment. Requires an active edit session.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Remove an application deployment

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the application deployment

items.docs: Removes an application deployment configuration from the domain. Requires an active edit session. This undeploys the application from all targets upon activation.

info.name: Library Deployments
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all shared library deployments

items.docs: Returns all shared library deployment configurations in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Create a shared library deployment

items.docs: Creates a new shared library deployment. Requires an active edit session.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get a shared library deployment

params.name: libraryName
params.description: The name of the shared library deployment

items.docs: Returns the configuration of a specific shared library deployment.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Remove a shared library deployment

params.name: libraryName
params.description: The name of the shared library deployment

items.docs: Removes a shared library deployment from the domain. Requires an active edit session.

info.name: Deployment Operations
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Deploy an application at runtime

items.docs: Deploys an application to the specified targets using the deployment manager. This is a runtime operation that does not require an edit session.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Undeploy an application at runtime

items.docs: Undeploys an application from the specified targets using the deployment manager.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Redeploy an application

items.docs: Redeploys an application, refreshing it from the source location. Can update the entire application or specific modules.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start a deployed application

items.docs: Starts a deployed application that is currently in the prepared or admin state, transitioning it to the active state.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Stop a deployed application

items.docs: Stops a deployed application, transitioning it to the prepared state where it no longer accepts client requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all deployment progress objects

items.docs: Returns progress information for all in-progress and recently completed deployment operations.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get deployment progress

items.docs: Returns progress information for a specific deployment operation.

info.name: Upload
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Upload an application archive

items.docs: Uploads an application archive (EAR, WAR, JAR) or deployment plan to the administration server upload directory for subsequent deployment.
